_comment: Row grouping for the weekly IcM on-call summary. Columns are fixed (New/Resolved/Mitigated + a Transferred-Out total); only these rows are configurable. The default groups by a single 'business category': source 'composite'. For each incident it first tries the rules below (first match wins; cf omitted = any cf for that team) — used ONLY to split a team by a custom field. If no rule matches, it falls back to the team's real IcM display name, fetched automatically via iris icm.teamsById (e.g. 67250 -> 'Region Access & Quota', 60533 -> 'CIS RPs'); only if that lookup fails does it use the raw team leaf. So you do NOT hand-write team display names here — just the cf splits. Alternatives: source 'column' (an Incidents column like Severity), source 'customField' (raw cf value). Order of dimensions = nesting.
_daytimeNote: On-call roster only counts the Sydney daytime shift (08:00-16:00); the rotation is follow-the-sun (3x8h/day) so without this one person shows as both primary and secondary. Set daytime to null to include all shifts.
_notes: Team display names are NOT configured here — they come from IcM automatically (iris icm.teamsById, backed by the on-call schedule TeamName). rules exist only to split a team by a custom field: here ServiceBlueprint's 'Execution Plan' and OnDemandQuota's Ev2 requests get their own category; everything else in those teams (and every other team) shows its IcM display name. The cf lives under two ids (45266, 45272) for different teams; both are listed in customFieldIds. Raw cf vocabulary seen: Blueprint, Execution Plan, Fulfillment (cf 45266); Other request related, Creating Request on Lionrock Portal, OnDemandQuota Ev2 extension (cf 45272). To split a team differently, add a rule; to merge/rename, add a rule with a shared name (a rule name overrides the IcM display name).
